_: Single source of every formula on the blended slots (src/projector/blend/) and in the ManimGL prototypes (tools/manim/). Conceptual blending after Fauconnier & Turner: two input spaces (neuronal / forest, silicon / chain), the generic space they share, and the blend. \class{key}{…} names the parts that TransformMatchingParts matches between formulas. Keep every displayed formula ASCII: MathJax draws a non-ASCII letter inside \text{} as an SVG <text> node, which SVGLoader drops — write accents as \acute{a}, \tilde{n}, \acute{\imath}.

computes.silicon: G/Gmax: el gas del bloque se acumula; lleno, se sella

s3.title: Prueba
s3.idea: Verificar sin revelar. El error de predicción solo deja pasar lo que no se esperaba; una prueba de conocimiento cero solo deja pasar que es cierto. La cláusula de opacidad.

s9.title: Huella
s9.idea: El circuito olfativo de la mosca es un hash sensible a la localidad (Dasgupta et al., 2017); la cadena firma con keccak256.

_stages: Slots 4-9 tell the dossier's automaton (Fig. 3) in key order: SENSED, PRESENT, OVERLAP, ADJUDICATED, then the two terminals INSCRIBED and OPAQUE. `header` is the stage line held at the top of the slot; `computes` say in one line per formula what the live number beside it is; `lexicon` are sentences in the voice of Estratos (slot E) and Registro (slot R), written under the blend in turn. All three are plain Spanish, set in the monospace of slot E's sentences (monoText, manim/tex.ts); only the formulas go through TeX, in its sans-serif.
